subject: Is hosting Shiny Application on a IIS7 (Microsoft) server not possible?

messages.author: 3eb89b02a307a23f
messages.subject: Is hosting Shiny Application on a IIS7 (Microsoft) server not possible?
parts:
Hi- my company currently uses an IIS7 server.  Is there no way to host a shiny application with this?  If not, will future versions support IIS7?

Thanks,
-Theo

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Is hosting Shiny Application on a IIS7 (Microsoft) server not possible?
parts:
Theo,

This seems to be a general question on Shiny rather then ShinyApps, which would be better suited for the shiny-discuss group, however I believe I can answer your question: To host Shiny applications, you need to either a) Run Shiny Server or Shiny Server Pro (Linux only) or b) Signup for ShinyApps and host applications in the cloud.

Hope that helps,
-Andy
